import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'log', '--oneline', 'base..HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("Commits:", result.stdout.strip())

# Verify tests still pass
result = subprocess.run(
    ['python', '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '-x', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', 
     'tests/test_bump.py', 'tests/test_compare.py', 'tests/test_deprecated_functions.py',
     'tests/test_docstrings.py', 'tests/test_format.py', 'tests/test_immutable.py',
     'tests/test_index.py', 'tests/test_match.py', 'tests/test_max-min.py',
     'tests/test_parsing.py', 'tests/test_pysemver-cli.py', 'tests/test_replace.py',
     'tests/test_semver.py', 'tests/test_subclass.py', 'tests/test_typeerror-274.py'],
    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120
)
print("Return code:", result.returncode)
# Get summary line
for line in result.stdout.split('\n'):
    if 'passed' in line or 'failed' in line or 'error' in line:
        print(line)
